title: stemodiacra glabra
intro: Stemodiacra glabra, commonly known as 'Tulsi', is a plant species from the family Lamiaceae, native to tropical regions of Asia. The health benefits of Stemodiacra glabra include its ability to reduce stress, alleviate respiratory issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The plant is known for its therapeutic actions, including sedation, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Stemodiacra glabra include essential oils, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
